text: It's a very cool app to use: very useful and way more effective than any other AI transcription app. I love the fact that it doesn't use your information for AI training, which is a very good thing. Just because you want to use an app doesn't mean you have to submit to AI training. The only thing I would recommend is the option to personalize the keyboard, such as adjusting the size or maybe even the color, so it suits personal choices more. Thank you.
